$comment: Crosswalk scheme registry. Only schemes with distribution 'shipped' may appear in the term files; mappings to 'hub_licensed' schemes are licensed hub data, stored by a hub outside this repository and validated with validateHubCrosswalk(). The engine works with no licensed crosswalk at all.

schemes.name: IFC 4.3 (ISO 16739-1:2024) entity and predefined type names
schemes.note: Entity names (optionally Entity.PREDEFINEDTYPE) written by the taxonomy authors from the open schema; not yet reviewed by an IFC expert.

schemes.name: ETIM product classes
schemes.note: Slots only. Class codes are filled from the ETIM classification under its terms of use after review; none are claimed in version 1.0.0.

schemes.name: MasterFormat
schemes.note: Proprietary. A hub that holds a licence supplies its own mapping; never committed here.

schemes.name: UniFormat
schemes.note: Proprietary. A hub that holds a licence supplies its own mapping; never committed here.

schemes.name: OmniClass
schemes.note: Licence terms set by its steward. A hub that holds a licence supplies its own mapping; never committed here.

schemes.name: Uniclass
schemes.note: Own terms of use; treated as hub data under ADR 012 decision 14. Never committed here.
